description: This file defines the SmallVector class and related templates, providing a small-optimized dynamic array implementation with in-place storage for small sizes, including modifications from LLVM's implementation for use in PyTorch (ATen).

classes.name: SmallVector
classes.description: A small-optimized variable-sized array with inline storage for small sizes, supporting copy/move semantics, iterator access, and various array operations.

classes.name: SmallVectorImpl
classes.description: Base class providing common implementation details for SmallVector, including iterator support and array manipulation methods.

classes.name: SmallVectorBase
classes.description: Base class managing raw storage pointers, size, and capacity, with support for growth and size management.

classes.name: SmallVectorStorage
classes.description: Template struct providing inline storage buffer, specialized for zero and non-zero inline elements.

classes.name: CalculateSmallVectorDefaultInlinedElements
classes.description: Helper struct computing default inline element count based on size constraints and sizeof(T).

methods.name: swap
methods.description: Swaps contents with another SmallVector or SmallVectorImpl, efficiently exchanging internal buffers and sizes.

methods.name: operator=
methods.description: Assignment operators for copying and moving SmallVector instances.

methods.name: push_back
methods.description: Adds an element to the end of the vector, growing storage if necessary.

methods.name: pop_back
methods.description: Removes the last element from the vector.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the vector to a specified size, optionally initializing new elements.

methods.name: reserve
methods.description: Ensures the vector has at least the specified capacity.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a range or multiple copies of an element to the vector.

methods.name: assign
methods.description: Replaces contents with a specified number of copies of an element or a range.

methods.name: erase
methods.description: Removes elements at a position or range.

methods.name: begin
methods.description: Returns iterator to start of elements.

methods.name: end
methods.description: Returns iterator to end of elements.

methods.name: data
methods.description: Returns pointer to internal storage buffer.
